551:t_009:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「She has earned the title of Empress she stole from me.」

551:t_009:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The engine has blown! We can't sail any farther!」

551:t_009:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Hold the ship in this position! Open the catapult!」

551:t_009:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm fine! If the booster's main system dies, we'll deal with it then!」

551:t_009:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm heading out, $$エド・ブルーザー・サックス$$...!」

551:t_011:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$! Our target point is there!」

551:t_012:0.en:
$n
「I've got your back, $$宗介$$! Just focus on breaking through!」

551:t_012:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You must enter the base and stop $$カナメ$$!」

551:t_012:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll clear out the small fry around you!」

551:t_012:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「In return, I'm counting on you to save $$かなめ$$!」

551:t_012:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Go save the person you love!」

551:t_012:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hold on, $$千鳥$$! I'm coming now!!」

551:t_013:0.en:
$$アル$$
「We have reached the target point.」

551:t_014:0.en:
$n
「I'll take care of the $$レーバテイン$$, $$宗介$$! Hurry inside!」

551:t_014:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's all right, $n. He can look after himself.」

551:t_014:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm counting on you to take care of the $$レーバテイン$$, $$アル$$!」

551:t_015:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード$$ tricked us! Neither he nor $$千鳥$$ is here!」

551:t_016:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this was all part of $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s trap!」

551:t_019:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「How was my first sniper shot since coming back?」

551:t_019:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I just made it. You've fallen for me all over again, haven't you, Sis?」

551:t_019:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I owe you, $$レイス$$... And you too, old man $$マッカラン$$...)

551:t_019:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
(For recovering me and my $$Ｍ９$$ from that hellhole of a battlefield and bringing us here.)

551:t_019:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
(But I'm not going to bore everyone explaining all that. A knight on a white horse makes his entrance dramatic and cool.)

551:t_019:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Now, $$メリッサ$$. Cry over my miraculous survival!)

551:t_019:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
(My final clincher will be, 'If you're in trouble, I'd come running even from the afterlife!')

551:t_019:10.en:
$$マオ$$
「Didn't you die a spectacular, manly death? Why are you showing your face here so shamelessly?」

551:t_019:13.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Give us back that sense of unity at the briefing.」

551:t_019:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's too bad, $$クルツ$$... It seems your character shines brightest when you're dead.」

551:t_019:20.en:
$$アル$$
「I cannot understand what everyone is saying.」

551:t_019:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll explain, $$アル$$. Everyone is happy.」

551:t_019:23.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, can you hear me, you white tin bastard!?」

551:t_019:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Be happy! Boss $$サックス$$ isn't dead! He's still hanging on!」

551:t_019:28.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Come on, you white tin bastard! I went to the trouble of telling you, so show some reaction!」

551:t_019:29.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant... I am now in the same state as when I discover the optimal tactics. Is this...?」

551:t_019:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right. That is the feeling of happiness.」

551:t_019:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do this, $$アル$$! We don't have time to stand still here!」

551:t_019:33.en:
$$アル$$
「I understand. Let us finish the enemy quickly, so I can ask Lieutenant $$サックス$$ to readjust the emergency deployment booster.」

551:t_019:34.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ウェーバー$$! Now that you're here, I'm putting you to work!」

551:t_019:35.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I understand! At this point, I don't give a damn anymore!」

551:t_019:37.en:
$$宗介$$
(Just you wait, $$レナード$$...! You won't get your way with me, my friends, the world, or $$千鳥$$!)

551:t_020:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「We have confirmed all enemies are destroyed.」

551:t_021:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Judging from $$アマルガム$$'s troop movements and the flow of supplies they use...」

551:t_021:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There is no doubt $$レナード$$ prepared his space-time repair system here on $$メリダ島$$.」
